comment: same issue here tbh. still got the bug after reinstalling everything and clearing cache, and now the price goes up on top of it lol. not paying more for something that doesn't play right, if it isn't fixed soon im moving to youtube music.

lmao 12.99 for premium and i still get three unskippable spotify ads before my podcast starts. premium is supposed to mean no ads, that's the whole point. one more ad in my show and i'm deleting my account, pay for premium means no ads.

another price bump, great. im on a multi month block so it doesn't hit me yet but my billing has been wrong twice this year already. does the new price apply to prepaid blocks or only monthly plans? anyone know?

ok so premium is 12.99 now and i already pay for youtube premium which comes with youtube music. makes less sense to keep paying for spotify every month. jam is the only reason i'm still here, the recs keep repeating and the app is bloated. honestly looking at youtube music seriously.

cool, more money for an app that already lost my new episodes folder and plays episodes in reverse. playlists and the UI are why i stay, but the podcast side keeps getting worse. not a good time for this.

still a bargain honestly. nearly the entire catalog ad free and offline for around 13 bucks a month is massively undervalued, and it means artists get paid. i've been through two increases now and it's still worth it for me. free listening is how artists get screwed.
lol premium going up to 12.99. not paying for it anyway, free spotify is ass but i can live with ads. if you want music without ads just buy youtube premium, way better deal imo.

great, they raise the price again and still can't keep features like crossfade in the app. stuff keeps disappearing and the ads keep increasing. i'm keeping it for now because the app is convenient but this is absolute garbage.
duo going up 2 bucks, meh. the new stuff eventually shows up on duo so i'm fine paying for that. dw still recycles the same songs though. shrug, we'll see what rolls out next.
11.99 to 12.99 is fine by me. still way cheaper than buying the albums i listen to, been paying since forever and no complaints here. ads on premium would be the only thing that makes me rethink it.

family goes to 21.99, so per person it's still cheap for our household but the price keeps creeping up. still no lossless on family either, which is annoying. not switching though, splitting with another service is way more hassle rn.

wtf, another price hike while the tablet premium perks still don't work and this update sucks. lossless sounds great when it works but the bugs are wearing me down. if the playback problems keep going i'm moving to apple music.
annoying but still worth it. the family plan is cheap per person and spotify connect across all my devices is hard to beat. alternatives are only slightly better so i'm not leaving over 12.99.

is anyone else seeing the price going up? premium already costs too much for me and i've been on and off since the card thing. playlists still keep resetting and i'm already half looking at apple music again.

another price rise and lossless is still region locked where i live. same price as everyone else but fewer features, which is not a good experience. worth its weight in gold for my parents' household plan though, so i'm not going anywhere.

great, more money for shuffle that still plays the same 10 to 15 songs from my 9000 track playlist. smart shuffle is broken and free shuffle was better anyway. at this price i'm seriously considering going back to youtube.

premium going up to 12.99 for features i think should come with the free app. why do i have to pay that just to skip more than a few songs? sick of having to pay for basic stuff. still using free, which is ridiculous at this point.

went up a dollar on individual. annoying but still worth it to me for the search and multi device sync. moving years of playlists elsewhere is not happening. might look at the playlist tools if it keeps going up though.
lol price going up again while songs won't play on their own and support just sends copy paste replies. amazon music is cheaper and has playlists spotify is missing. i'm done paying for this for now.
not my problem anymore, i cancelled over the ai slop in discover weekly. still don't love how little of the money reaches artists. price hike doesn't change anything for me.

paying more and still no true lossless on windows or android? cheaper services already offer it. the features are hard to give up on wireless earbuds so i'll stay for now, but tidal keeps getting more of my listening.
eh, a buck more doesn't bother me. i don't hear a difference on bluetooth anyway so lossless wouldn't be the thing i'd pay for. 320 is fine.

they keep raising prices and the discography is still missing. family plan is the only reason i'm still here. soundcloud with an adblocker and buying albums is looking better and better, screw the monthly sub.

more money from me and artists still get pennies while the ceo is a billionaire. i already buy music directly when i can. the subscription is only worth it if it actually supports artists, and right now it's a money vacuum.
apple music is cheaper with better audio, and now spotify goes up again. i keep coming back because my shared playlists and the discovery are still better for me, but it's getting harder to justify.
student is going to 6.99 which is still cheaper than full premium, but i'm already stressed about re verifying every year. i just want to keep my hulu, that's the only reason i'm on the student plan.
raising prices while ai slop and fake artists flood discover weekly? nah. i already left once and i'm not paying more to fund this. pay the artists, not the ceo.

premium going up is fine by me, i've paid for over ten years and the library is basically a work tool for transcribing. i love spotify but the recommendations still suck. not going anywhere, can't go back to apple music.
